branch: slice/c-m-mock, with origin/main 8ae3b3c3 (PR #118 Decisions) merged in
method: Isolated chrome-headless-shell, throwaway profile, private CDP port, focus emulated. The page was served from a loopback server that logged every request. Viewport screenshots at deviceScaleFactor 1, scrollbars hidden as on phones and macOS. Each load: mockup.html?n=<k>#state=<name>&theme=system&controls=hide with prefers-color-scheme emulated.
files: mock-shots/<spec state>-<state name>-<width>-<scheme>.png. Spec state 3 is split into 3a loading and 3b failed, 7 into 7a link, 7b without the key and 7c phrase, 9 into 9a landed, 9b typed and 9c open. 10a to 10c are the band with every control: closed at 1920 to 320, More open on a phone, and the copy panel under the collapsed band.
band: The band is main at 8ae3b3c3 for this fixture: a fresh relic has decisions open and none recorded, so Decisions shows a zero tally beside Comments. Mock filename widths 31.3px at 390 and 65.2px at 320 match the 31px and 64 to 65px the Decisions stylesheet records for the real band.

checks.oneRequest: exactly one request per load, the document, in both the browser and the server log
checks.noErrors: no page errors, console errors or console warnings
checks.noHOverflow: documentElement and body scrollWidth no wider than the viewport
checks.dashFree: no en or em dash in any text on the page
checks.noPhraseOutsidePanel: no phrase word in any text outside the panel
checks.toastClean: no toast contains the fragment or a phrase word
checks.panelInside: panel inside the viewport, and neither the panel nor the phrase slip overflows sideways
checks.wordsWhole: every phrase word renders on one line, inside its cell, with no overlap; numbers come from a CSS counter
checks.copyLinkVisible: with the sheet unscrolled, the primary Copy link sits wholly inside the panel and the viewport
checks.pressedInView: 320 only, states 6 and 7c: the pressed Copy phrase is focused and wholly visible under the pinned head
checks.underBar: panel top within 1px of the band bottom
checks.placement: 1440: panel right edge within 1px of the opener right edge; 390 and 320: panel spans the viewport
checks.columns: phrase slip is three columns at 1440 and 390, two at 320
checks.keyWhole: the key part of the link renders as one unbroken fragment
checks.linkText: link value text is exactly the share URL
checks.expanded: opener has aria-expanded="true" and aria-controls="copy-link-panel" while the panel is open
checks.c1Text: every C1 string the panel shows is present word for word
checks.toastAbove: toast z-index 30 and elementFromPoint at its centre is the toast
checks.keyEntryText: KEY_ENTRY_PROMPT, KEY_ENTRY_LABEL and KEY_ENTRY_PLACEHOLDER word for word
checks.decisionsTally: the Decisions tally chip on the band is displayed, unclipped and wider than 40px
checks.bandFits: band scrollWidth no wider than clientWidth, and every shown control inside the viewport
checks.identityFloor: identity at least 192px above 832px, 128px above 544px, 88px at or below 544px (12rem, 8rem, 5.5rem)
checks.versionClear: version chip wholly inside the identity and clear of the first control
checks.controlsNamed: every shown control has an accessible name, and every one showing no words has a title
checks.moreOpen: More disclosure open: aria-expanded true, its list inside the viewport, four entries each with words
